sampled_visual_review.review_type: sampled image review, not whole-video visual acceptance
observations: The sampled stages remain visually synchronized: hand pose, gripper targets, ARM masks, inpainted scene, robot rendering and final composite.
Visible hand/shadow ghosting and local blur remain in ProPainter backgrounds, including parts of the interaction area. These artifacts remain in the composite.
Robot rendering satisfies the configured quantitative constraints; physical scale and real scene object collisions have not been validated.
DA3 depth preview contains structured scene/hand depth. It is estimated from RGB, not measured sensor depth.
